about: SEAM-273: SeamTrail reads this list from GitHub to tell a chat on an older plugin how to update it, and shows the same steps in Settings → Agents · MCP connector → Plugins. One entry per published plugin; each version must equal its plugin's own (tests/updates.sh checks). update: terminal commands run one after the other; where: where to run them; after: what to do next in the assistant; autoUpdate: how to have the assistant update it by itself (null when it cannot); tried: the steps were tried in the real assistant.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.where: in a terminal, in your repository's folder
claude-code.after: type /reload-plugins in the chat, or start a new chat
claude-code.autoUpdate: in Claude Code, type /plugin, open Marketplaces, pick seamtrail and choose Enable auto-update
